name: celyes/ralph-php
description: A Ralph-style development loop for PHP: reads tasks from a Markdown checklist, delegates them to a coding agent, verifies the result, and commits the work.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Handles Ctrl+C during a run: stops the agent, records the interruption, and releases the repository lock only once the worker is confirmed stopped.
suggest.ext-posix: Stops the whole process tree of an agent that spawned children, so none is left running in a task worktree.

scripts-descriptions.test:installation: Install the package as a project dependency and as a global tool, and check the installed binary.
scripts-descriptions.test:example: Check the shipped example project: its own suite, its configuration and checklist, and a task run through the loop in a copy of it.
